notes: OpenMono already ships a Docker sandbox, a 'nothing bypasses the pipeline' chokepoint,
fixed doom-loop detection (3x repeated tool sequence) and per-sub-agent turn budgets.
This adapter does NOT replace any of that. It adds the one thing those controls lack:
persistence across sessions. OpenMono enforces; ThumbGate remembers and tightens.

loopDetection.note: Upstream aborts on any 3x repeat. Adaptive mode learns which sequences preceded wasted runs in THIS repo and denies those earlier, while leaving legitimate retry loops alone.

blastRadius.note: Paths outside the container workspace mount are treated as escape attempts.

receipts.note: One signed receipt per tool attempt (allow and deny), for teams that must evidence what an agent touched.
